Senses.Explanation: A white egret standing in snow places one white form against another without making the bird and its setting the same thing. Chan verses and answers pair the egret and snow to test sameness within visible distinction: several explicitly ask how white differs from white, while others place the image beside moonlight, silver bowls, or the paired trace-formula “fish move, water clouds; birds fly, feathers fall.”
